description: Dimensions: Centre to Top 320/420/510mm, Centre to Centre 280/364/450mm. This is a great opportunity to purchase the chassis of the ever popular Thorn Menu2. The Me'n'u2 is carries one adult and two children. Suggested rider ages / size; front rider; 5’4” upwards, middle rider; children 7 to 12, rear rider 4 years to 10. These went out of production several years ago when supply issues arose and ever since we have been buying back and selling complete bikes to and from very happy customers. We have recently had one more production of these frames. To keep the cost affordable in these times of recession, we have had them painted in a workmanlike yellow powdercoat, there may be some cosmetic blemishes but this really has kept the price to a minimum. Frame features; Mudguard eyes and mounts, front lowrider mounts, rear rack mounts, 5 x bottle bosses and a rear ISO disc mount. Does not include: forks, eccentrics, fixing screws, down tube cable stops or bottom brackets You may like to add out item # 23407 Frame Workshop Prep (Includes all threads tapped and stainless bolts fitted for racks, mudguards and bottle bosses.) If unsure of size please contact Thorn on 01278 441505, Monday to Thursday from 8.00am to 4.00pm or sales@thorncycles.co.uk. Please note that we no longer have an open showroom.
